newsitem.title: USA: ADE files for 2.47 mln share offer.
newsitem.headline: ADE files for 2.47 mln share offer.

text.p: ADE Corp filed Wednesday with the Securities and Exchange Commission to register an offering of up to 2.47 million shares, of which the company will offer two million shares and a group of shareholders will sell 470,000 shares.

The Westwood, Mass, company that makes inspection systems used in the semiconductor industry, said proceeds from the shares it sells will be used for general corporate purposes, including research and development and future acquisitions.
Underwriters for the offering, Alex Brown & Sons Inc, Montgomery Securities, Adams Harkness & Hill Inc, Sutro & Co Inc and Needham & Co Inc, have an over-allotment option of up to 370,500 shares.
After the offering, the company will have 10,604,160 shares outstanding.
